items.exampleEn: My aunt is a policewoman in Kaohsiung.
Her first name is very long.
You need ID to open a bank account.
items.exampleZh: 開銀行帳戶需要身分證明。

items.exampleEn: My ID card has an old photo of me.
items.exampleZh: 我身分證上的照片是很久以前拍的。

items.exampleEn: My cousin wants to be a police officer.
Is there a police station near here?
I bought some stamps at the post office.
items.exampleZh: 我在郵局買了一些郵票。

items.sentenceEn: The post office closes at five today.

items.audioEn: I lost my wallet, so I went to the police station.
items.audioZh: 我弄丟了皮夾，所以去了警察局。
items.questionZh: 說話的人為什麼去警察局？

items.sentenceEn: Please show your ID card at the door.
items.sentenceZh: 請在門口出示你的身分證。

items.sentenceEn: The policewoman was very kind to the children.
items.sentenceZh: 那位女警對孩子們非常親切。

items.stemEn: I want to send this box to my aunt. Where is the ____?
items.stemZh: 我想把這個箱子寄給我阿姨，郵局在哪裡？

items.stemEn: My ____ is Kevin, and my surname is Lee.
items.stemZh: 我的名字是 Kevin，姓是 Lee。

items.passageEn: Yesterday, Amy lost her wallet on the bus. Her ID card and some money were in it. She went to the police station near her school. A kind police officer asked for her first name and surname, and Amy showed her student card as ID. Two hours later, a policewoman called her. Someone found the wallet and took it to the post office!
items.passageZh: 昨天，Amy 在公車上弄丟了皮夾，裡面有她的身分證和一些錢。她去了學校附近的警察局。一位親切的警察問了她的名字和姓，Amy 拿出學生證當作身分證明。兩個小時後，一位女警打電話給她：有人撿到皮夾，把它送到郵局了！

referenceEn: The police station is next to the post office.
The police station is right next to the post office.
rubricZh: 「警察局」用 police station、「郵局」用 post office

items.promptZh: 我叔叔當了二十年的警察。
referenceEn: My uncle has been a police officer for twenty years.
My uncle was a police officer for twenty years.
rubricZh: 用 police officer 表示「警察」
時態可用現在完成式或過去式（例如 has been、was 等）
